bio.text: Judy Amabile, a Democrat, has represented District 18 in the Colorado State Senate since January 2025; she previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives from 2021 to 2025.
Her current Senate term ends January 10, 2029.
Amabile was born in New Rochelle, New York, and earned a B.A. and an M.B.A. from the University of Colorado Boulder.
Her career experience includes co-founding Product Architects Inc. and working as a senior consultant with Coopers and Lybrand; she also co-founded Good Business Colorado.
